title: Full day Tour with Private Driver in Quebec
blurb:
This VIP tour has it all!

In the 9 hours tour, I will take you to the most beautiful sites of the Quebec City Region, including the UNESCO city centre of Old Quebec, the Montmorency Falls, the Beaupré Coast, with its magnificient Sainte-Anne'S Basilica, and the picturesque Island of Orleans with its 6 villages dating from the 17th century. 

This tour will tell you everything there is to know about Quebec City, through its French, British and Canadian eras, always keeping in mind that this land was shared with many indigenous nations, such as the Algonquian and Iroquoian.
